summary.conclusion: A future Google Ads read-only adapter is feasible only through a new narrow internal adapter around GoogleAdsReadonlySyncService.sync with strict isolation and guards.

google_ads_inventory.purpose: Synchronize Google Ads account, entity, RSA, and daily metric data into local cache with a durable sync run.
google_ads_inventory.scope: Active local Google ad accounts, optionally filtered by requested normalized customer IDs.
tests: Rejects a query containing mutate before credential loading.
gaps: No retry/backoff or explicit rate-limit handling.
No distributed lock or sync idempotency.
No maximum date range or date ordering policy.
No fail-closed rejection for unknown requested customer IDs.
Unexpected failure can leave a run in running.
No export-job linkage or per-account durable status.
No exact outbound endpoint/method allowlist test.

google_ads_inventory.purpose: Manual sync trigger and latest-run read.
google_ads_inventory.risk: Director and Manager currently have google-ads.read, so broad read permission can trigger provider sync and read sync details.

google_ads_inventory.risk: Not isolated for data-pack use; helper can schedule business recalculation and lacks equivalent durable sync-run/error controls.

readonly_candidate_matrix.mutation_risk: low only after narrow adapter isolation; high if broad module/controller is reused
readonly_candidate_matrix.recommendation: Wrap only this method in a new isolated internal adapter with exact transport and local-write allowlists.
Do not reuse for google_ads adapter.
Do not treat as provider freshness adapter.

mutation_risk_map.why_forbidden: Constructs and submits provider mutation operations.
mutation_risk_map.additional_guard: Adapter dependency graph must exclude all operation/action services.
No mutation dependency; never infer budget ID from campaignId/adGroupId.

mutation_risk_map.current_guard: Action policy; auto-control currently disabled until approval integration.

mutation_risk_map.why_forbidden: Calls mutate and prepares execution even when validateOnly=true.
mutation_risk_map.additional_guard: Treat as execution path and exclude.

mutation_risk_map.current_guard: Approval, provider validation, idempotency, production/provider/dry-run flags, google-ads.execute.

mutation_risk_map.why_forbidden: Pre-export must never mutate provider resources.
mutation_risk_map.additional_guard: Contract-level deny-all except exact searchStream read.

credential_rbac_security_review.finding: Google refresh token and provider config are encrypted in tokenEnc/providerConfigEnc using AES-256-GCM; production requires API_TOKEN_SECRET.
credential_rbac_security_review.risk: ApiToken schema and service retain legacy plaintext token/notes fallbacks.
credential_rbac_security_review.recommendation: Keep adapter credentials internal and remove/migrate Google plaintext fallback in a separately approved security change.

credential_rbac_security_review.finding: Repository uses OAuth 2.0 refresh-token exchange through google.auth.OAuth2.
credential_rbac_security_review.risk: Access-token exchange collapses all failures to undefined.
credential_rbac_security_review.recommendation: Return sanitized typed internal auth errors; do not add service-account support without separate review.

credential_rbac_security_review.risk: Pattern/key redaction does not make arbitrary raw provider payloads safe.
credential_rbac_security_review.recommendation: Persist bounded typed errors only; never raw headers/body/stack.

credential_rbac_security_review.finding: Current readonly sync route inherits google-ads.read, held by Director and Manager.
credential_rbac_security_review.risk: Broad read permission can trigger provider calls.
credential_rbac_security_review.recommendation: Use dedicated internal ai-data-pack.source-sync.google-ads.readonly.execute permission and separate sanitized sync-detail read permission.

credential_rbac_security_review.finding: Sync filters requested IDs against active local Google accounts.
credential_rbac_security_review.risk: No dedicated allowlist or fail-closed unknown-ID rejection; login-customer pairing is not explicitly policy validated.
credential_rbac_security_review.recommendation: Fail closed on normalized customer/login-customer scope before credential load/provider call.

credential_rbac_security_review.finding: Sync runs contain customer IDs and errors.
credential_rbac_security_review.risk: Customer IDs reveal account topology even though they are not credentials.
credential_rbac_security_review.recommendation: Restrict sync-detail reads and sanitize errors.

timeout_retry_rate_limit.retry_behavior: Exponential backoff with jitter; honor safe provider retry guidance.
timeout_retry_rate_limit.concurrency: Bounded per worker and customer/login-customer scope.

persist scope hash and export-job link

partial_failure.partial_when: At least one approved step succeeds and another fails.

no_mutation_invariants: Only exact searchStream provider endpoint is reachable.
No mutation/action/execution dependency is in the adapter module graph.
Only allowlisted local cache and sync-run writes occur.

future_flow: Run existing DB-only source registry/freshness/coverage assessment.
If policy allows and google_ads is stale or lacks required coverage, validate scope and acquire lock.
Call narrow Google Ads read-only adapter.
Write approved local cache and durable sync run only.
Re-run existing DB-only freshness and coverage assessment.

future_official_export.fresh_with_zero_report_date_coverage: Does not pass; canRecommendAdsScale remains false.

required_future_prerequisites: Official/partial job lifecycle in separate approved scope.

test_plan: Adapter never calls mutate, validateOnly, create, update, delete, or status methods.
Transport rejects every origin/path/method except allowlisted searchStream POST.
No caller-supplied URL, method, or GAQL is accepted.
Read-only sync writes only approved local collections and never deletes.
Invalid or unapproved customer/login-customer scope fails before credentials/provider call.
Timeout, total deadline, retry, backoff, rate-limit, and bounded concurrency work.
Authentication/policy/query errors are not retried.
Distributed lock prevents concurrent equivalent provider sync.
Idempotency reuses a compatible successful run for sync_if_stale.
Every started sync run reaches a terminal status.
Per-account/step failure produces partial or failed correctly.
Provider and secret errors are typed, bounded, and redacted.
Stale source triggers adapter only when future policy allows.
Fresh and covered source skips adapter.
Cached export never resolves or calls adapter.
Provider failure becomes a warning and is followed by DB-only reassessment.
Fresh timestamp with zero report-date coverage keeps ads-scale gate false.
canImportActionFile, canDryRun, and canExecuteLive remain false.
Existing GET exports remain side-effect-free.
Adapter module dependency graph contains no action, validation, execution, evaluation, post-execution, emergency, or auto-control service.
RBAC denies broad google-ads.read users from triggering internal adapter sync.

risks_and_assumptions.item: Broad GoogleAdsModule exports read and mutation/execution services together.
Current google-ads.read permission is too broad for provider-sync execution.
Provider latency, quota/rate limits, auth, version, and per-account permission differences can produce partial coverage.
No current distributed lock or provider-sync idempotency.
Successful provider response or fresh timestamp does not prove report-date coverage.
Legacy plaintext credential/config fallback weakens encrypted-storage invariant.
Current redaction cannot make arbitrary raw provider payloads safe.
ERP remains the only component allowed to call Google Ads.
Pre-export adapter can only read provider and upsert approved local cache/audit.
Final freshness and coverage decisions remain DB-only after sync.
Official and partial exports are not authorized in Prompt 6.
OAuth refresh-token mechanism remains the approved Google Ads credential method unless separately reviewed.
